put.description: Update the price section in bulk for multiple items. This is useful for implementing pricing strategies across your catalog, such as seasonal discounts, competitive pricing adjustments, or clearance sales.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

MPItem[].sku.description: The SKU of the item for which the price is being updated.

MPItemFeedHeader.businessUnit.description: The business unit for which the feed is submitted. For example, use 'Walmart_US' for U.S. Marketplace.

MPItem[].price.description: The selling price of the item on Walmart.com.

MPItemFeedHeader.version.description:
The version of the feed schema being used.
Please use `5.0.20250328-17_43_36-api` for the PRICE section updates and use `2.0.20240126-12_25_52-api` for PROMO&DISCOUNT section updates.

MPItem[].description: Add (+) or map items here from a previous step.

MPItem[].msrp.description: The manufacturer's suggested retail price (MSRP) for the item.

MPItemFeedHeader.locale.description:
The locale code for the content in the feed.

For example, `en` for English.

MPItem[].businessPrice.description:
The business price for the item. Unlike the `price` field, which is visible to everyone, the `businessPrice` is only visible to verified business organizations and non-profits. In the Walmart ecosystem, setting a `businessPrice` that is lower than your standard retail price can help you:
- Win the Business Buy Box
- Encourage Bulk Purchasing from retailers.

- `en` for US
- `es` for MX & CL
- `en` & `fr` for CA.

MPItem[].price.description: **required** The current selling price of the item on Walmart.com.

- WALMART_CA for CA
- WALMART_MEXICO for MX
- WALMART_CHILE for CL..

MPItemFeedHeader.subset.description:

MPItem[].promotionInformation.promotionP.description: The UTC date and time when the promotional price ends.

- `WALMART_MEXICO` for MX

put.description: Cancel one or more order lines for a specific `purchaseOrderId`.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

purchaseOrderId.description: Unique Walmart purchaseOrderId that identifies the purchase order.

userInputLines[].lineNumber.description: Identifier of the specific order line to be cancelled.

userInputLines[].description: Array of objects, each specifying cancellation details for an individual order line.

userInputLines[].unitOfMeasurement.description: Unit of measure for the status quantity (such as EACH or EA), defining how the `amount` is counted.

userInputLines[].amount.description: Numeric value representing how many units to be cancelled.

userInputLines[].cancellationReason.description:
Reason for cancellation. Example: 'CUSTOMER_REQUESTED_SELLER_TO_CANCEL'.

Cancellation reason should not be "CUSTOMER_REQUESTED_SELLER_TO_CANCEL" for non intent to cancel orders'

Cancellation reason should not be
"SELLER_CANCEL_FRAUD_STOP_SHIPMENT" for non fraudulent orders. If you suspect fraud, contact Walmart Risk Prevention Team (MPFraudReq@customercare.walmart.com). Include PO details and reason you suspect the order. We will contact you in 2-4 hours. If your suspicion of fraud is proven, we will cancel the order and notify you.

If you select the cancellation reason as "SELLER_CANCEL_OUT_OF_STOCK", Walmart will mark the specific item as out of stock in the selected warehouse. To make the item available for sale again, please replenish its inventory.

post.description: This API allows you to create a new Campaign.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

itemsOperations.operationType.description:
Type of operation to perform on campaign Items.

Allowed Values: `ADD`, `REMOVE`

metadata.name.description: Name of the campaign. Allowed characters: letters, digits, dashes, underscores, and spaces. Maximum 255 characters allowed.

itemsOperations.description: List of Operations to perform on campaign items.

metadata.startDate.description: Start date of the campaign in yyyy-MM-dd format.

metadata.endDate.description: End date of the campaign in yyyy-MM-dd format.

metadata.dailyBudget.description: Daily budget allocated for the campaign. Must be a positive value with up to 2 decimal places. Daily budget must be between $5.00 and $2,500.00.

metadata.totalBudget.description: (optional) Total budget allocated for the campaign. Must be a positive value with up to 2 decimal places. Total budget must be between $5.00 and $250,000.00. Total budget must be greater than or equal to daily budget.

metadata.biddingStrategyType.description: Bidding strategy type for the campaign. Defaults to `TARGET_ROAS` if not specified.

metadata.targetRoas.description:
Target ROAS for the campaign. Must be a positive value between 1.00 and 20.00, with up to 2 decimal places.

Defaults to `3.5` if not specified.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

purchaseOrderId.description: Unique Walmart purchaseOrderId that identifies the purchase order.

processMode.description: Optional. If updating tracking info after shipment, set this fields value to: PARTIAL_UPDATE to indicate a partial update of shipping information.

userInputLines[].lineNumber.description: Identifier of the specific order line to be cancelled.

userInputLines[].trackingInfo.carrier.description: The package shipment carrier. Valid entries are: UPS, USPS, FedEx, Airborne, OnTrac, DHL Ecommerce - US, DHL, LS (LaserShip), UDS (United Delivery Service), UPSMI (UPS Mail Innovations), FDX, PILOT, ESTES, SAIA, FDS Express, Seko Worldwide, HIT Delivery, FEDEXSP (FedEx SmartPost), RL Carriers, Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery, China Post, YunExpress,Yellow Freight Sys, AIT Worldwide Logistics, Chukou1, Sendle, Landmark Global, Sunyou, Yanwen, 4PX, GLS, OSM Worldwide, FIRST MILE, AM Trucking, CEVA, India Post, SF Express, CNE, TForce Freight, AxleHire, LSO, Royal Mail, ABF Freight System, WanB, Roadrunner Freight, Meyer Distribution, AAA Cooper, Canada Post, Southeastern Freight Lines, Japan Post, Correos de Mexico, XPO Logistics, JD Logistics, YDH, JCEX, Flyt, Deutsche Post, Better Trucks, Asendia, SFC, UBI, ePost Global, YF Logistics, RXO, Estes Express, Shypmax, WIN.IT America, PITT OHIO, PostNord Sweden, Equick, Whistl, Tusou, Shiprocket, DTDC, PTS.

userInputLines[].description: Array of objects, each specifying cancellation details for an individual order line.

userInputLines[].intentToCancelOverride.description: Optional. If the customer has requested cancellation, toggle on to confirm you still intend to ship the order.

userInputLines[].trackingInfo.otherCarri.description: Custom name for a shipping carrier when the carrier is not one of the predefined options; if used, a valid trackingURL must also be provided.

userInputLines[].sellerOrderId.description: Seller-defined order ID (max 30 characters). Walmart prints this ID on return labels so the seller can reference the sales order.

userInputLines[].trackingInfo.methodCode.description: Shipping service level for the package (such as Standard, Express, OneDay, WhiteGlove, Value, Freight), indicating delivery speed or handling.

userInputLines[].sellerOrderNo.description: Seller’s unique purchase order number for this order, used internally when creating or updating orders.

userInputLines[].trackingInfo.trackingNu.description: Current alphanumeric identifier assigned by the carrier, used to update the purchase order’s tracking status.

userInputLines[].trackingInfo.trackingUR.description: URL where the shipment status can be tracked online. Mandatory when using a custom otherCarrier name.

userInputLines[].trackingInfo.shipDateTi.description: Timestamp in UNIX epoch (int64) format representing the exact date and time the package was shipped.

userInputLines[].unitOfMeasurement.description: Unit of measure for the status quantity (such as EACH or EA), defining how the amount is counted.

userInputLines[].amount.description: Numeric value representing how many units fall into the specified status category.

userInputLines[].trackingInfo.description: Object containing shipment and tracking details for the package, including carrier information, shipping method, shipment timestamp, tracking number, and optional tracking URL'

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

quantity.unit.description: A unit of measure. Walmart Marketplace supports only EACH which indicates one individual sellable item.

sku.description: A unique alphanumeric ID you assign to each item. Use the same value in every request that references the item, including your XSD catalog file.

quantity.description: The quantity that customers have ordered but you haven't shipped yet.

quantity.amount.description: The number of units pending shipment.

inventoryAvailableDate.description: The date when this inventory becomes available at the ship node. Use ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). If you omit this field, Walmart treats the inventory as available today.

shipNode.description: The unique ID of the ship node (fulfillment center) where you want to update inventory. If you omit this parameter, Walmart updates inventory at your default ship node.
